overlap.comparison: Has a same-parity plateau on a different two-integer-coordinate polytope, with two common critical caps and global normalized depth 1/3. The present example has one unique minimizing through direction at each vertex and an arbitrarily small nonglobal plateau, with exact comparison to a deeper actual point.

Proves strict interpolation under an affine base segment parameter bounded in [0,1] on the entire positive support. The present marks are interior to the positive base hull, so that premise fails. The supporting-trace regularity result 1269c554ca9a41b8 also has different hypotheses.

readability: Uniqueness is among oriented through-point directions, up to positive scaling. The example compares a low plateau with the target and does not compare the global maximum to it.
